cases.name: the answers the page opens with
cases.why: the smallest configuration that loads: an account, one destination, and the token referenced rather than written
cases.config:
github:
  token: ${GITHUB_TOKEN}
targets:
  user: octocat
sinks:
  stdout: true
cases.step:
- uses: jmrplens/ghchronicle@v2
  with:
    token: ${{ secrets.GHCHRONICLE_TOKEN }}
    config: .github/ghchronicle.yaml

cases.name: a cadence per family, under every.families
cases.why: the nested form. The flat every block it replaced is fatal, and the loader has a migration hint for it, so the builder must never write one
cases.config:
github:
  token: ${GITHUB_TOKEN}
targets:
  user: octocat
sinks:
  stdout: true
every:
  default: 30m
  groups:
    ci: 5m
  families:
    deps: 24h
    joblogs: 12h
    traffic: 6h
heartbeat: 1m
cases.step:
- uses: jmrplens/ghchronicle@v2
  with:
    token: ${{ secrets.GHCHRONICLE_TOKEN }}
    config: .github/ghchronicle.yaml

cases.name: private repositories left out
cases.why: include_private is a tri-state: the absent key means on, so writing false has to be the thing that turns it off
cases.config:
github:
  token: ${GITHUB_TOKEN}
targets:
  user: octocat
  orgs: [some-org, another-org]
  exclude: ["someone/experiment-*"]
  include_forks: true
  include_archived: false
  include_private: false
sinks:
  stdout: true
cases.step:
- uses: jmrplens/ghchronicle@v2
  with:
    token: ${{ secrets.GHCHRONICLE_TOKEN }}
    config: .github/ghchronicle.yaml

cases.name: a sink whose credentials are environment references
cases.why: a token is never written into the file; the file names the variable and the loader expands it
cases.config:
github:
  token: ${GITHUB_TOKEN}
targets:
  user: octocat
sinks:
  influxdb:
    url: http://influx:8181
    token: ${INFLUX_TOKEN}
    bucket: github
    batch: 5000
  telegraf:
    url: http://telegraf:8186/telegraf
    password: ${TELEGRAF_PASSWORD}
  elasticsearch:
    url: http://elasticsearch:9200
    api_key: ${ES_API_KEY}
cases.step:
- uses: jmrplens/ghchronicle@v2
  with:
    token: ${{ secrets.GHCHRONICLE_TOKEN }}
    config: .github/ghchronicle.yaml

cases.name: a card and nothing else
cases.why: the shape a run with -card-only takes, the only one the loader accepts with no destination configured, and the only one whose answers an Action step can carry without a file at all
cases.config:
github:
  token: ${GITHUB_TOKEN}
targets:
  user: octocat
  include_private: true
cases.step:
- uses: jmrplens/ghchronicle@v2
  with:
    token: ${{ secrets.GHCHRONICLE_TOKEN }}
    include-private: "true"
    user: octocat
    mode: card
    card: generated/card.svg

cases.name: a narrowed sweep
cases.why: groups is a pointer for the same reason include_private is: no key at all means every group, and an empty list is refused
cases.config:
github:
  token: ${GITHUB_TOKEN}
targets:
  user: octocat
sinks:
  stdout: true
  stdout_format: json
groups: [account, audience, collector]
log:
  level: debug
  format: json
cases.step:
- uses: jmrplens/ghchronicle@v2
  with:
    token: ${{ secrets.GHCHRONICLE_TOKEN }}
    config: .github/ghchronicle.yaml

cases.name: every sink at once
cases.why: each sink has required keys of its own, and a sink switched on with nothing else set has to reach the loader as a sink rather than as a null

  token: ${GITHUB_TOKEN}
targets:

sinks:

cases.name: a credential answered with the credential
cases.why: the likeliest mistake on the page, and the one the promise above the outputs is about: a credential field takes the NAME of a variable, and an answer that is not one is left out of the file rather than uppercased into a reference to a variable that will never exist

answers.github.token: a pasted token, not a name
answers.sinks.telegraf.password: a pasted password, not a name

cases.config:
targets:
  user: octocat
sinks:
  stdout: true
  telegraf:
    url: http://telegraf:8186/telegraf
cases.step:
- uses: jmrplens/ghchronicle@v2
  with:
    token: ${{ secrets.GHCHRONICLE_TOKEN }}
    config: .github/ghchronicle.yaml

cases.name: a header that references nothing
cases.why: the OTLP headers are the one field whose documented purpose is to carry a credential, and the one the form writes exactly as typed: a value with no ${…} in it is the value itself, in the file, and the form says so rather than rewriting it
cases.config:
github:
  token: ${GITHUB_TOKEN}
targets:
  user: octocat
sinks:
  otlp:
    endpoint: http://otel:4318
    headers:
      X-Scope-OrgID: tenant-a
  stdout: true
cases.step:
- uses: jmrplens/ghchronicle@v2
  with:
    token: ${{ secrets.GHCHRONICLE_TOKEN }}
    config: .github/ghchronicle.yaml

cases.name: a list answered with nothing but separators
cases.why: an answer that looks filled in and has no entries. An empty list is not the same as no key: the loader refuses an empty groups list, and a list that collapsed to [] would be a sweep of nothing
cases.config:
github:
  token: ${GITHUB_TOKEN}
targets:
  user: octocat
sinks:
  stdout: true
cases.step:
- uses: jmrplens/ghchronicle@v2
  with:
    token: ${{ secrets.GHCHRONICLE_TOKEN }}
    config: .github/ghchronicle.yaml

cases.name: a destination switched on and left empty
cases.why: the commonest way to answer this form into a file that cannot start: a sink is a checkbox, its keys are not, and the run is refused by name
cases.step:
- uses: jmrplens/ghchronicle@v2
  with:
    token: ${{ secrets.GHCHRONICLE_TOKEN }}
    config: .github/ghchronicle.yaml

cases.name: nothing answered at all
cases.why: the form starts answered, but every control can be cleared, and an empty file is a file: the loader has to say it is empty rather than report the end of it
cases.step:
- uses: jmrplens/ghchronicle@v2
  with:
    token: ${{ secrets.GHCHRONICLE_TOKEN }}
    include-private: "false"
    mode: card
    card: generated/card.svg

cases.name: a number answered with a word
cases.why: a numeric control is a number input on the page and free text to anyone who types into it another way, so the emitter writes what it was given and the loader is the one that refuses it
cases.config:
github:
  token: ${GITHUB_TOKEN}
  reserve_rate: many
targets:
  user: octocat
sinks:
  stdout: true
cases.step:
- uses: jmrplens/ghchronicle@v2
  with:
    token: ${{ secrets.GHCHRONICLE_TOKEN }}
    config: .github/ghchronicle.yaml
